mutations.label: slow-tests: a duration belongs to the assertion above it, so an innocent test is never named as the slow one
mutations.from: pending = { name: assertion[3], depth: assertion[1].length / 4, ok: assertion[2] === 'ok' }
mutations.to: pending = { name: assertion[3], depth: 0, ok: assertion[2] === 'ok' }
mutations.only: ^(?:a suite line is not counted, because it carries the sum of its children)$

mutations.label: slow-tests: a median of zero is UNRUN, not a run in which everything is infinitely slow
mutations.from: if (mid === null || mid <= 0) return { median: mid, unusable: true, found: [] }
mutations.to: if (mid === null) return { median: mid, unusable: true, found: [] }
